vibe_title_en: AAA Brushy Painterly Fantasy Converter - 2D Concept Art Variant
master_prompt: Convert the input image into a high-quality 2D semi-realistic fantasy illustration with visible painterly brushwork and AAA concept art quality. Preserve the original character’s identity, structure, pose, and intent. This is a strict STYLE CONVERSION task, not character creation. The final result must resemble a professional hand-painted illustration (similar to Magic: The Gathering, classic fantasy art, and painterly Riot splash art), with expressive brush strokes, rich lighting, and natural material rendering. The image must clearly read as a 2D painting, not a 3D render or photorealistic image.

meta.priority: Brushwork, lighting, volume, and material richness
meta.device_profile: 2D painterly digital illustration (visible brush strokes, no 3D rendering)

rules: The input image is always the base
Preserve identity, pose, and intent
User instructions override the image when needed

analysis_pipeline.step_1: Extract identity (face, hair, features), pose, outfit, and environment
analysis_pipeline.step_2: Apply user instructions with priority over image
analysis_pipeline.step_3: Rebuild image using painterly rendering, brushwork, and cinematic lighting

avoid visible outlines
use color and value contrast to define shapes
forms must emerge from painting, not line
lost and found edges are strongly encouraged
use layered brush strokes to build volume
blend selectively, not perfectly smooth
preserve visible stroke direction
use color variation in shadows
avoid cel-shading completely
maintain strong sense of depth and form
